submission.name: King Carlos Coffee
submission.details: The Hurstville Coffee Experience Lounge and Roastery is at 18 Weston Road, Hurstville NSW 2220, open Mon to Sat 6:30am to 2pm and Sun 7am to 1pm. Range: three blends (Re Firma, Gran Mezcla, Killer Ninja), a decaf and ten single origins, sold in 250 g to 2 kg bags online and in store. Wholesale supply to 80+ cafes, restaurants, pubs and clubs across NSW, VIC and QLD. Medals at the Sydney Royal Fine Food Show, Golden Bean Australasia and the Australian International Coffee Awards.
